cardOverview.overviewText: A straightforward cashback card offering flat cashback across categories like groceries, fuel, dining, and online shopping, designed for users who value simplicity and instant benefits.

benefitRows.offer: 25% off up to INR 800 on EazyDiner.|Minimum Order Value INR 2500
